title: Build GET /goals/:id/progress endpoint
description:
## Context
PRD v0.1.0 section 4.3 — needed for HQ Goal Hierarchy Tree and Goals Dashboard.

## Task
Create new endpoint: `GET /goals/:id/progress`

Response shape:
```json
{
  "goalId": "string",
  "issueCount": 0,
  "doneCount": 0,
  "inProgressCount": 0,
  "todoCount": 0,
  "percentComplete": 0,
  "childGoalCount": 0,
  "childGoalsAchieved": 0
}
```

## Implementation
- Count issues where `goalId = :id` grouped by status
- Count child goals where `parentId = :id`, and how many have status = 'achieved'
- percentComplete = doneCount / issueCount * 100 (0 if issueCount = 0)

## Files to change
- `server/src/routes/goals.ts` — add new route
- `server/src/services/goals.ts` — add `getProgress(id)` method
- DB query joins `issues` table on `goalId`

## Success Criteria
- Returns correct counts for a goal with linked issues
- Returns zeros gracefully for goal with no linked issues
- Tested with at least 3 test cases

title: Add read_goals, create_goal, update_goal_status tools to DonDog/Chef/Alfie Letta adapters
description:
## Context
PRD v0.1.0 section 4.3 — agents need to read and write goals as part of their normal operation.

## Task
Add three new custom tools to the Letta Cloud adapter for DonDog, Chef, and Alfie:

### read_goals(level?, status?)
- Calls `GET /companies/:companyId/goals?level=:level&status=:status`
- Returns list of goals
- Agent IDs: DonDog (agent-2402fdcd), Chef (agent-e09ccc12), Alfie (agent-f9288018)

### create_goal(title, description, level, parentId?)
- Calls `POST /companies/:companyId/goals`
- Returns created goal

### update_goal_status(goalId, status)
- Calls `PATCH /goals/:goalId` with `{ status }`
- Returns updated goal

## Implementation Notes
- Tools live in the letta-cloud adapter: `packages/adapters/letta-cloud/`
- Same pattern as existing paperclip tools (read_paperclip_issues, etc.)
- Use PAPERCLIP_BASE_URL and PAPERCLIP_API_KEY env vars for auth

## Success Criteria
- All 3 tools registered for DonDog, Chef, Alfie in Letta Cloud
- DonDog can call `read_goals(level='team', status='active')` and get results
- Chef can call `create_goal(...)` and new goal appears in Doer
- Alfie can call `update_goal_status(id, 'achieved')` and status updates

title: Update Alfie dispatch to create agent goals and pass goalId to sub-issues
description:
## Context
PRD v0.1.0 section 4.3 — Alfie must create agent-level goals when dispatching gremlins.

## Task
Update Alfie's system prompt / work instructions:
1. When decomposing a team goal into gremlin sub-issues:
   - Create an agent-level goal for each gremlin: `create_goal(title, desc, 'agent', teamGoalId)`
   - Set `ownerAgentId` to the gremlin's agent ID
   - Set the agent goal status to 'active' when dispatching

3. On each heartbeat, call `read_goals(level='agent', status='active')` to check gremlin goal health
4. If agent goal active >48h with no issue progress, escalate to DonDog

- Every gremlin dispatch creates a corresponding agent goal
- Sub-issues have goalId set to the agent goal

title: Build in-app Letta agent chat proxy endpoint
description:
## Context
PRD v0.1.0 section 4.1 — backend for in-app chat.

## Task
Create chat proxy in Doer's Express server:

### Endpoint
`POST /api/agents/:agentId/chat`
Body: `{ message: string }`
Response: streaming (SSE or chunked) of agent response tokens

### API Key Storage
- New field on agent record: `lettaApiKeyEncrypted` (AES-256-GCM)
- Encryption key from `DOER_ENCRYPTION_KEY` env var (32 bytes, base64)
- NEVER expose to browser client
- New endpoint: `POST /api/agents/:agentId/letta-key` to set/update the key
- Key rotation UX: if Letta API returns 401, return `{ error: 'KEY_INVALID', message: 'API key invalid — update in agent settings' }` to UI

### Proxy Logic
- Decrypt stored key
- Forward to Letta API: `POST /v1/agents/:agentId/messages`
- Stream response back
- Concurrency lock: reject second chat if one is active (return 409)

### DB changes
- Add `lettaApiKeyEncrypted: text` column to agents table
- Migration required

## Success Criteria
- Chat proxy works end-to-end with a Letta Cloud agent
- API key never appears in browser network traffic
- 401 from Letta triggers KEY_INVALID error response
- Concurrent session rejected with 409
- DOER_ENCRYPTION_KEY missing = server startup error with clear message

title: Integrate @letta-ai/letta-client SDK into Doer server for Letta-native agent lifecycle
description:
## Context
PRD v0.1.0 section 4.4 — Letta Agent Workspace Migration. Flagship feature of v0.1.0.

## Task
Add `@letta-ai/letta-client` as a dependency to `server/` and build the Letta-native agent lifecycle layer:

### Agent creation (Letta-native type)
When user creates an agent in Doer with type = 'letta-native':
```
client.agents.create({ model, memory_blocks, tools }) 
→ store returned letta_agent_id on Doer agent record
→ configure memfs binding
→ agent.type = 'letta_native'
```

### Letta client config
- LETTA_BASE_URL env var (default: Letta Cloud)
- LETTA_API_KEY env var
- Client initialized once in server startup

### Agent deletion
- On Doer agent delete: `client.agents.delete(letta_agent_id)` + clean up memfs

### New DB fields on agents table
- `lettaAgentId: text | null` — Letta's UUID for this agent
- `agentType: 'adapter' | 'letta_native'` — default 'adapter'

### New service: `lettaAgentService`
- `provision(doerAgentId, config)` — create in Letta, store ID
- `deprovision(doerAgentId)` — delete from Letta, clear ID
- `getClient()` — returns configured Letta client instance

## Success Criteria
- `@letta-ai/letta-client` installed and importable in server
- Letta-native agent creation flow works end-to-end
- `lettaAgentId` stored correctly on agent record
- Agent deletion cleans up Letta agent
- Works in packaged Electron app (no native binary deps)

## Reference

title: Log Letta-native agent runs, tool calls, and memory ops to Doer DB
description:
## Context
PRD v0.1.0 section 4.4 — full observability is the core value of Letta-native agents.

## Task
Intercept and log all Letta-native agent activity to Doer's database:

### What to log
1. **Runs** — start/end time, trigger (heartbeat/chat/manual), status
2. **Tool calls** — tool name, input JSON, output JSON, duration ms, error if any
3. **Memory reads/writes** — block name, operation type, snippet (first 200 chars)

### New DB tables
- `agent_runs` — id, agentId, startedAt, completedAt, triggerType, status
- `agent_tool_calls` — id, runId, agentId, toolName, input, output, durationMs, error, calledAt  
- `agent_memory_ops` — id, runId, agentId, blockName, operation, snippet, occurredAt

### Implementation approach
- After each Letta SDK message call, parse the response messages for tool_call and tool_return types
- Insert to DB in background (don't block response)
- Prune old records: keep 30 days or 1000 records per agent, whichever is less

## Success Criteria
- After a Letta-native agent handles a message, tool calls appear in `agent_tool_calls`
- HQ Tool Call Log panel (section 4.2) reads from Doer DB for letta-native agents (not Letta API)
- Memory operations captured
- Pruning job runs on a schedule
